sources.entry: YingTu - Browser playground for testing AI image and video API routes, prompts, reference inputs, task status, and downloads before integration. #free

summary.name: YingTu
summary.one_liner: YingTu is an online AI image studio, built on the LaoZhang API, that generates and edits images with Nano Banana, GPT Image and Seedream models and bills per image.
use_cases: Generate images from text prompts without a monthly subscription
Edit a photo with reference images, such as swapping backgrounds
Split an image into layers for a layered PSD
Make sticker packs for messaging apps
Prototype image API calls before writing code
summary.what_it_does: YingTu is a browser studio offering 8 image models, including Nano Banana Pro, Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2 and 2.5, and Seedream 5.0 Flash and Pro, with output up to 4K depending on model. Users can generate images from prompts or upload up to 5 reference images (20 MB each) for edits. It includes a layer decomposition tool that outputs a layered PSD or ZIP of transparent PNGs, plus sticker, poster and product photo workflows and prompt templates. Each generation can show Python code for the equivalent LaoZhang API call. The page also lists AI video studios for Seedance and Wan 2.7, which require the user's own LaoZhang key.
notable: Pay-per-image pricing from $0.018 with no subscription, billed through LaoZhang
Layer decomposition into transparent PNG layers and layered PSD export
Generations show Python code for the same LaoZhang API call
API key and history stored in the user's browser rather than on YingTu servers
caveats: Not unlimited free: the $0.1 trial credit is only for Gmail sign-ins and expires after 30 days
Video (Seedance, Wan) needs a separate LaoZhang key and is not covered by the free credit
Independent studio, not an official Google or OpenAI product
